study type: Observational cohort study (using administrative claims data)
exposure: Metabolic syndrome conditions (obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure, high triglycerides, low HDL)
outcome: Perinatal mental illness (prenatal prevalence and postpartum incident diagnoses)
Time to incident mental disorder diagnosis postpartum
cohort: The study participants were 372,895 perinatal women identified from a US administrative claims database, continuously enrolled from 1 year prior to 1 year post-delivery between 2014 and 2019.
finding: The risk of mental disorder (both prenatal prevalence and postpartum incident) was significantly associated with metabolic syndrome conditions, showing an incremental relationship with the number of conditions.
